title: M9 — Isolate AWS costs and gate cloud rendering with spend controls
description:
## Outcome
M9 — Isolate AWS costs and gate cloud rendering with spend controls

## Ownership
Babulus infrastructure; dedicated Babulus/VideoML AWS member account

## Decision
VideoML includes voiceover and open Auritus-backed local synthesis. Babulus is an optional paid rendering service with portable inputs and outputs.

## Completion
Child behavior stories pass with linked evidence. Architecture, region, budgets, grace period, pilot pricing, and limits are decided in initiative D01–D15. Only real deployment identity facts require validation before provisioning; do not invent them. Dispatch the bounded packets, not this epic as a single coding task.
